# Play — Unlucky for Some

- SudokuPad: [Unlucky for Some on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Unlucky for Some on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed), including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
All three rules are native to f-puzzles (`killercage`, `littlekillersum`, `xsum`). This is the same JSON that Rangsk's solver read when
it confirmed uniqueness. I have not opened the links in a browser myself. The X-sums are the three 13s **without** an arrow: above column 4,
right of row 6 and below column 1. If an app draws them like ordinary text, the rules text says which they are. `grid.svg` in this folder
is the reference picture (X-sums in italics).

Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (constraints, solution).
